item.tib: pho nya dreg pa bco brgyad kyi las kha
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni dben gnas ma d+hal ri khrod du/ dbra rigs kho bo bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal bdag la me rta zla tshes kyi nub mor/ dbal 'bar stag la me 'bar gyis bsnyen (snyan) du brgyud bzhin gu ger bris pa 'dis kyang dun tse ma lus myur du 'jom pa'i rten du shog/
